name: lebane.app
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds.
lesson: Keep body text at a 4.5:1 contrast ratio or more against its background.
summary: www.lebane.app scores 75 out of 100 (C). 2 checks fail now, 25 are at risk, and 42 pass. Fix first: tracking starts on load and no banner asks first.

fix.title: Tracking starts on load and no banner asks first
fix.evidence: No cookie banner appeared. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Microsoft Clarity (5 requests), LinkedIn Insight (5 requests), HubSpot (2 requests), Meta Pixel (2 requests), Google Ads (1 request), Google Analytics (2 requests), and…
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 21 elements on /, /producto/contabilidad, /producto/contratos, for example #w-tabs-1-data-w-tab-1 > .func-tab_link_wrapper > div:nth-child(2) and #w-tabs-1-data-w-tab-2 > .func-tab_link_wrapper > div:nth-child(2). Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: swiper 11 has a known flaw
fix.evidence: swiper 11 (https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/swiper@11/swiper-bundle.min.js): 1 known flaw, the worst rated critical, such as CVE-2026-27212. Swiper versions >=6.5.1 and <12.1.2 are vulnerable to Prototype Pollution that bypasses a previous fix. The indexOf()…
fix.fix: Upgrade swiper to 12.1.2 or later. A major upgrade changes behavior, so retest the pages that use it.

fix.title: 10 structured data items miss a property Google expects
fix.evidence: / SoftwareApplication lacks offers or aggregateRating, /producto/contabilidad SoftwareApplication lacks offers or aggregateRating, /producto/contratos SoftwareApplication lacks offers or aggregateRating and 7 more.
fix.fix: Fill the missing properties so the item qualifies for rich results.

fix.title: X-Content-Type-Options is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers may guess a file's type and run it as script. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.
